text:
Ivy (CS): Quick FYI  Bluehaven renewal scheduled next week. They9re proposing to shorten from 12mo -> 8mo, add 18 seats, and split invoices between Bluehaven EU and Bluehaven US. Procurement asks to prepay EU invoice; they want onboarding credit applied only if EU prepays. Also requesting net30 on US invoice, net45 on EU. Any legal/billing concerns?
Connor (AE): Willing to hold unit price if they prepay EU. Need to confirm revenue recognition with finance.
Rahul (Legal): Split invoices + mixed payment terms OK. Need precise language: "Onboarding credit contingent on EU prepayment and will only apply to the EU invoice if payment clears within 10 business days." I can draft an amendment.
Nora (Billing): We can do split invoices and differing payment terms. Prepayment flow is manual: we hold credit application until payment posts. If they want the credit split otherwise, we need written instruction. Also need vendor codes and VAT/GST for EU.
Ivy (CS): Customer also requests two enablement workshops within 30 days and a go-live checklist with 3 acceptance items. PMs ok?
Connor (AE): I'll confirm prepay commitment and get PO numbers + vendor codes today. Will ask finance about revenue recognition impact.
Rahul (Legal): I'll add the contingency clause and a fallback: "If EU prepayment not received within 10 business days, onboarding credit will be cancelled or reallocated by mutual agreement." Routing to DocuSign after PO names confirmed.
Nora (Billing): Once amendment signed and payment posts, I can issue EU invoice as paid and apply the one-time credit there. For the US invoice I will set net30 as requested. Need vendor codes + bank remittance details by COB Wed.
OpsBot: Generated invoice preview:
```
BLUEHAVEN EU (Entity A) -  13,500 EUR - 10 seats (8mo prorated) - prepay requested
BLUEHAVEN US (Entity B) - $7,200 USD - 8 seats (8mo prorated) - net30
Onboarding credit: 1,500 EUR - contingent on EU prepayment
```
Ivy (CS): Thanks. Summary / owners:
- Connor: confirm EU prepay + collect PO/vendor codes (owner)
- Rahul: draft amendment + DocuSign
- Nora: prepare split invoice templates and prepay validation flow
- Ivy: prepare onboarding checklist and tentatively schedule 2 sessions
I'll update the tracker and ping if PO/vendor codes delayed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
